title_zh: 核对贺卡与礼物包裹邮资

scenario.label_zh: 办理礼物包裹与贺卡邮寄
scenario.goal_zh: 核对邮寄去向、标签和贺卡邮资并交寄

context_zh: 顾客索菲把一份礼物包裹和一张单独寄送的贺卡带到邮局，由柜员帕特核对。费用仅属虚构练习。
author: author-phase06-a

sentences.speaker: Sophie
sentences.text: This package and this card are both going to my aunt in Bristol.

sentences.speaker: Pat
sentences.text: The address on the package is clear. Could you add the postcode to the card as well?

sentences.speaker: Sophie
sentences.text: Of course. There, I've copied it from the parcel label.

sentences.speaker: Pat
sentences.text: Thank you. The parcel postage is six pounds, plus one pound for the card. Seven pounds altogether.

sentences.speaker: Sophie
sentences.text: I'll pay by card. Do I tap here?

sentences.speaker: Pat
sentences.text: Yes. Your payment has gone through. Here is your receipt.

sentences.speaker: Sophie
sentences.text: Thank you. Do you take both items now?

sentences.speaker: Pat
sentences.text: Yes, I'll put them with today's outgoing post.
